messages.subject: Extra 16-way intercross
parts:
Hi Karl,

I have a design, similar to the "reduced MAGIC design" produced by Stadlmeier et al. (2018; https://doi.org/10.3389/fpls.2018.01825). It contains 8 founder lines with an additional 16-way cross. How would I describe the cross_info for this?

Thank you,
Conor

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: Extra 16-way intercross
parts:
I'm not sure I understand the design, or what you mean by "an additional 16-way cross".

8-way RIL by selfing ("riself8") requires information on the order of the founders in producing each line.
https://kbroman.org/qtl2/assets/vignettes/input_files.html#Multi-parent_recombinant_inbred_lines

Alternatively, you can use the "generic" 8-way RIL ("genril8"), which requires a value for the effective number of outcrossing generations plus the relative contributions of the 8 founders (presumably all equal?).
https://kbroman.org/qtl2/assets/vignettes/input_files.html#General_recombinant_inbred_lines

karl

I can't find an example file, but if you read in the CC data from github.com/rqtl/qtl2data, you can use the cross2_ril_to_genril function in qtl2convert:

cc <- qtl2::read_cross2("https://github.com/rqtl/qtl2data/raw/main/CC/cc.zip")
cc_genril <- qtl2convert::cross2_ril_to_genril(cc)
head(cc_genril$cross_info)
#              n_gen A B C D E F G H
# CC001/Unc        8 1 1 1 1 1 1 1 1
# CC002/Unc        8 1 1 1 1 1 1 1 1
# CC003/Unc        8 1 1 1 1 1 1 1 1
# CC004/TauUnc     8 1 1 1 1 1 1 1 1
# CC005/TauUnc     8 1 1 1 1 1 1 1 1

In the yaml file, "alleles" should be 8 single-character codes for the founder alleles. Like this:

alleles:
  - A
  - B
  - C
  - D
  - E
  - F
  - G
  - H

The first warning about genotypes treated as missing: "H", "2/1", "2/3", ...
this must mean that those codes are used in your genotype data. But R/qtl2 can only handle biallelic markers and the 3 possible genotypes have to use the same code across all markers, say A/H/B or AA/AB/BB.

genotypes:
  A: 1
  H: 2
  B: 3

karl
